## A heading glued to prose
This line sits directly under it, with no blank line between.

$$
\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$ {#eq-conformance}

The high-$$d$$ behaviour is the mid-line case, and the one place the two
configurations deliberately disagree about a run of ordinary prose.

> A blockquote is somebody else's voice, not a style to apply.
